messages:
Priya Narang: Hi all  kit arrived but a couple issues: monitor stand screws don't match the VESA holes (looks like 75mm vs 100mm pattern), and my wireless keyboard arrived with the 'F' keycap missing. Also trying to join corp Wi-Fi and it drops to a captive portal asking for a device registration token. Ticket IT-5123 created. Who do I tag? :confused:

Owen (IT): Tagging self on IT-5123. Thanks for the details. For the Wi-Fi captive portal: are you getting redirected to `register.redwood.ai` with a 6-digit token prompt? If so, try the device onboarding link from the welcome email or run `curl -v https://register.redwood.ai/health` to see redirect behavior and paste output. For the keyboard we'll either ship a replacement keycap or replace the keyboard if needed.

Priya Narang: Yes the browser redirects to register.redwood.ai and asks for a 6-digit code. Running `curl -v https://register.redwood.ai/health` shows 302 redirect to `https://sso-portal.redwood.ai/onboard`. I don't see a token in the welcome email though. :thinking:

OnboardingBot: Ticket IT-5123 assigned to Owen (IT). Facilities request REF-9012 created for alternate VESA screw set. Keyboard spare keycaps reserved under KIT-KC-003. Device registration token email resend queued.

Kai (Facilities): Hi Priya  I can drop a VESA adapter plate and a small screw kit at your desk in 2 hours. Desk is 5A-03, right? If not tell me location. I'll include a shrink-wrap bag for the screws.

Owen (IT): Priya  I resent the device token to your Redwood email. Try the token from the email in the captive portal. If it still loops, open a private browser window and paste the token manually. If the curl shows a redirect loop, paste the full curl response here and I'll escalate to network.

Priya Narang: Got the token email, pasted it in the portal and it accepted! Connected to corp-secure. Thanks Owen. Desk is 5A-03, Kai. Happy to try the VESA adapter when it arrives. Also small note: the keyboard's stabilizer under where the F key should sit is a hair cracked so a keycap won't stay flush. If spare keycap doesn't fix it I can take a replacement keyboard.

Kai (Facilities): Copy that  dropping the VESA adapter and screw kit at 3:15pm. If the keycap fix doesn't work, I'll coordinate a full keyboard swap with Owen. Leaving a sticky with REF-9012 code.

Owen (IT): Marking Wi-Fi resolved in IT-5123. I'll keep the keyboard on the ticket until you confirm the spare keycap fits. If it's cracked we'll issue a replacement and schedule a swap. Closing network portion. :white_check_mark:

Priya Narang: Everything's much better now, thanks team! Appreciate the fast help and the warm welcome :smile:
